verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem

Yaa ayyuhan-naasu ittaqoo rabbakumul-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsin waahidatin wa khalaqa minhaa zawjahaa wa baththa minhumaa rijaalan katheeran wa nisaa'an wattaqoo Allaahal-ladhee tasaa'aloona bihi wal-arhaama innallaaha kaana alaykum raqeebaa
Wa aatul-yataamaa amwaalahum wa laa tatabaddalul-khabeetha bit-tayyibi wa laa ta'kuloo amwaalahum ilaa amwaalikum innahu kaana hooban kabeeraa

Wa in khiftum allaa tuqsitoo fil-yataamaa fankihoo maa taaba lakum minan-nisaa mathnaa wa thulaatha wa rubaa'a fa-in khiftum allaa ta'diloo fawaahidatan aw maa malakat aymaanukum dhaalika adnaa allaa ta'ooloo
Wa aatun-nisaa saduqaatihinna nihlatan fa-in tibna lakum an shay'in minhu nafsan fakuloohu hanee'an maree'aa
Wa laa tu'tus-sufahaa'a amwaalakumul-latee ja'ala Allaahu lakum qiyaaman warzuqoohum feehaa waksoohum wa qooloo lahum qawlan ma'roofaa

Wabtalul-yataamaa hattaa idhaa balaghun-nikaaha fa-in aanastum minhum rushdan fadfa'oo ilayhim amwaalahum wa laa ta'kuloohaa israafan wa bidaaran an yakbaroo wa man kaana ghaniyyan falyasta'fif wa man kaana faqeeran falya'kul bil-ma'roofi fa-idhaa dafa'tum ilayhim amwaalahum fa-ashhidoo alayhim wa kafaa Billaahi haseebaa
Lir-rijaali naseebun mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboona wa lin-nisaa'i naseebun mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboona mimmaa qalla minhu aw kathura naseeban mafroodaa
Wa idhaa hadaral-qismata ulul-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeenu farzuqoohum minhu wa qooloo lahum qawlan ma'roofaa
Wa lyakhshal-ladheena law tarakoo min khalfihim dhurriyyatan di'aafan khaafoo alayhim falyattaqoo Allaaha wa lyaqooloo qawlan sadeedaa
Innal-ladheena ya'kuloona amwaalal-yataamaa zulman innamaa ya'kuloona fee butoonihim naaran wa sayaslawna sa'eeraa

Yooseekumu Allaahu fee awlaadikum lidh-dhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayni fa-in kunna nisaa'an fawqa ithnatayni falahunna thuluthaa maa taraka wa in kaanat waahidatan falahan-nisfu wa li-abawayhi likulli waahidin minhumas-sudusu mimmaa taraka in kaana lahu waladun fa-in lam yakun lahu waladun wa warithahu abawaahu fali'ammihith-thuluthu fa-in kaana lahu ikhwatun fali'ammihis-sudusu min ba'di wasiyyatin yoosee bihaa aw daynin aabaa'uukum wa abnaa'uukum laa tadroona ayyuhum aqrabu lakum naf'an fareedatan mina Allaahi innallaaha kaana aleeman hakeemaa

Wa lakum nisfu maa taraka azwaajukum in lam yakun lahunna waladun fa-in kaana lahunna waladun falakumur-rubu'u mimmaa tarakna min ba'di wasiyyatin yooseena bihaa aw daynin wa lahunnar-rubu'u mimmaa taraktum in lam yakun lakum waladun fa-in kaana lakum waladun falahunnath-thumunu mimmaa taraktum min ba'di wasiyyatin toosoona bihaa aw daynin wa in kaana rajulun yoorathu kalaalatan aw imra'atun wa lahu akhun aw ukhtun falikulli waahidin minhumas-sudusu fa-in kaanoo akthara min dhaalika fahum shurakaa'u fith-thuluthi min ba'di wasiyyatin yoosaa bihaa aw daynin ghayra mudaarrin wasiyyatan mina Allaahi Wallaahu aleemun haleem
Tilka hudoodu Allaahi wa man yuti'i Allaaha wa rasoolahu yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa dhaalikal-fawzul-azeem
Wa man ya'si Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa yata'adda hudoodahu yudkhilhu naaran khaalidan feehaa wa lahu adhaabun muheen
Wal-laatee ya'teenal-faahishata min nisaa'ikum fastashhidoo alayhinna arba'atan minkum fa-in shahidoo fa-amsikoohunna fil-buyooti hattaa yatawaffaahunnal-mawtu aw yaj'ala Allaahu lahunna sabeelaa
Wal-ladhaani ya'tiyaanihaa minkum fa-aadhoohumaa fa-in taabaa wa aslahaa fa-a'ridoo anhumaa innallaaha kaana tawwaaban Raheemaa
Innamat-tawbatu alaa Allaahi lilladheena ya'maloonas-soo'a bijahaalatin thumma yatooboona min qareebin fa-ulaa'ika yatoobu Allaahu alayhim wa kaana Allaahu aleeman hakeemaa

Wa laysatit-tawbatu lilladheena ya'maloonas-sayyi'aati hattaa idhaa hadara ahadahumul-mawtu qaala innee tubtul-aana wa lal-ladheena yamootoona wa hum kuffaarun ulaa'ika a'tadnaa lahum adhaaban aleemaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa yahillu lakum an tarithun-nisaa karhan wa laa ta'duloohunna litadhhaboo biba'di maa aataytumoohunna illaa an ya'teena bifaahishatin mubayyinatin wa aashiroohunna bil-ma'roofi fa-in karihtumoohunna fa-asaa an takrahoo shay'an wa yaj'ala Allaahu feehi khayran katheeraa
Wa in aradtumu istibdaala zawjin makaana zawjin wa aataytum ihdaahunna qintaaran falaa ta'khudhoo minhu shay'an ata'khudhoonahu buhtaanan wa ithman mubeenaa
Wa kayfa ta'khudhoonahu wa qad afdaa ba'dukum ilaa ba'din wa akhadhna minkum meethaaqan ghaleezaa
Wa laa tankihoo maa nakaha aabaa'uukum minan-nisaa illaa maa qad salafa innahu kaana faahishatan wa maqtan wa saa'a sabeelaa

Hurrimat alaykum ummahaatukum wa banaatukum wa akhawaatukum wa ammaatukum wa khaalaatukum wa banaatul-akhi wa banaatul-ukhti wa ummahaatukumul-laatee arda'nakum wa akhawaatukum minar-radaa'ati wa ummahaatu nisaa'ikum wa rabaa'ibukumul-laatee fee hujoorikum min nisaa'ikumul-laatee dakhaltum bihinna fa-in lam takoonoo dakhaltum bihinna falaa junaaha alaykum wa halaa'ilu abnaa'ikumul-ladheena min aslaabikum wa an tajma'oo baynal-ukhtayni illaa maa qad salafa innallaaha kaana ghafooran Raheemaa

Wal-muhsanaatu minan-nisaa illaa maa malakat aymaanukum kitaaba Allaahi alaykum wa uhilla lakum maa waraa'a dhaalikum an tabtaghoo bi-amwaalikum muhsineena ghayra musaafiheena famas-tamta'tum bihi minhunna fa-aatoohunna ujoorahunna fareedatan wa laa junaaha alaykum feemaa taraadaytum bihi min ba'dil-fareedati innallaaha kaana aleeman hakeemaa

Wa man lam yastati minkum tawlan an yankihal-muhsanaatil-mu'minaati famin maa malakat aymaanukum min fatayaatikumul-mu'minaati Wallaahu a'lamu bi-eemaanikum ba'dukum min ba'din fankihoohunna bi-idhni ahlihinna wa aatoohunna ujoorahunna bil-ma'roofi muhsanaatin ghayra musaafihaatin wa laa muttakhidhaati akhdaanin fa-idhaa uhsinna fa-in atayna bifaahishatin fa-alayhinna nisfu maa alal-muhsanaati minal-adhaabi dhaalika liman khashiyal-anata minkum wa an tasbiroo khayrun lakum Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Yureedu Allaahu liyubayyina lakum wa yahdiyakum sunanal-ladheena min qablikum wa yatooba alaykum Wallaahu aleemun hakeem
Wallaahu yureedu an yatooba alaykum wa yureedul-ladheena yattabi'oonash-shahawaati an tameeloo maylan azeemaa
Yureedu Allaahu an yukhaffifa ankum wa khuliqal-insaanu da'eefaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa ta'kuloo amwaalakum baynakum bil-baatili illaa an takoona tijaaratan an taraadin minkum wa laa taqtuloo anfusakum innallaaha kaana bikum Raheemaa
Wa man yaf'al dhaalika udwaanan wa zulman fasawfa nusleehi naaran wa kaana dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseeraa
In tajtaniboo kabaa'ira maa tunhawna anhu nukaffir ankum sayyi'aatikum wa nudkhilkum mudkhalan kareemaa

Wa laa tatamannaw maa faddala Allaahu bihi ba'dakum alaa ba'din lir-rijaali naseebun mimmaa iktasaboo wa lin-nisaa'i naseebun mimmaa iktasabna was'aloo Allaaha min fadlihi innallaaha kaana bikulli shay'in aleemaa
Wa likullin ja'alnaa mawaaliya mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboona wal-ladheena aqadat aymaanukum fa-aatoohum naseebahum innallaaha kaana alaa kulli shay'in shaheedaa

Ar-rijaalu qawwaamoona alan-nisaa bimaa faddala Allaahu ba'dahum alaa ba'din wa bimaa anfaqoo min amwaalihim fas-saalihaatu qaanitaatun haafizaatun lilghaybi bimaa hafiza Allaahu wal-laatee takhaafoona nushoozahunna fa-izoohunna wahjuroohunna fil-madaaji'i wadriboohunna fa-in ata'nakum falaa tabghoo alayhinna sabeelan innallaaha kaana aliyyan kabeeraa
Wa in khiftum shiqaaqa baynihimaa faab'athoo hakaman min ahlihi wa hakaman min ahlihaa in yureedaa islaahan yuwaffiqi Allaahu baynahumaa innallaaha kaana aleeman khabeeraa

Wa'budoo Allaaha wa laa tushrikoo bihi shay'an wa bil-waalidayni ihsaanan wa bidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wal-jaari dhil-qurbaa wal-jaaril-junubi was-saahibi bil-janbi wabnis-sabeeli wa maa malakat aymaanukum innallaaha laa yuhibbu man kaana mukhtaalan fakhooraa
Al-ladheena yabkhaloona wa ya'muroonan-naasa bil-bukhli wa yaktumoona maa aataahumu Allaahu min fadlihi wa a'tadnaa lilkaafireena adhaaban muheenaa
Wal-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum ri'aa'an-naasi wa laa yu'minoona Billaahi wa laa bil-yawmil-aakhiri wa man yakunish-shaytaanu lahu qareenan fasaa'a qareenaa
Wa maadhaa alayhim law aamanoo Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa anfaqoo mimmaa razaqahumu Allaahu wa kaana Allaahu bihim aleemaa
Innallaaha laa yazlimu mithqaala dharratin wa in taku hasanatan yudaa'ifhaa wa yu'ti min ladunhu ajran azeemaa
Fakayfa idhaa ji'naa min kulli ummatin bishaheedin wa ji'naa bika alaa haa'ulaa'i shaheedaa
Yawma'idhin yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo wa asaw ar-rasoola law tusawwaa bihimul-ardu wa laa yaktumoona Allaaha hadeethaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa taqrabus-salaata wa antum sukaaraa hattaa ta'lamoo maa taqooloona wa laa junuban illaa aabiree sabeelin hattaa taghtasiloo wa in kuntum mardaa aw alaa safarin aw jaa'a ahadun minkum minal-ghaa'iti aw laamastumun-nisaa falam tajidoo maa'an fatayammamoo sa'eedan tayyiban famsahoo biwujoohikum wa aydeekum innallaaha kaana afuwwan ghafooraa
Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseeban minal-kitaabi yashtaroonad-dalaalata wa yureedoona an tadillus-sabeel
Wallaahu a'lamu bi-a'daa'ikum wa kafaa Billaahi waliyyan wa kafaa Billaahi naseeraa

Minal-ladheena haadoo yuharrifoonal-kalima an mawaadi'ihi wa yaqooloona sami'naa wa asaynaa wasma ghayra musma'in wa raa'inaa layyan bi-alsinatihim wa ta'nan fid-deeni wa law annahum qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa wasma wanzurnaa lakaana khayran lahum wa aqwama wa laakin la-anahumu Allaahu bikufrihim falaa yu'minoona illaa qaleelaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba aaminoo bimaa nazzalnaa musaddiqan limaa ma'akum min qabli an natmisa wujoohan fanaruddahaa alaa adbaarihaa aw nal-anahum kamaa la-annaa ashaabas-sabti wa kaana amru Allaahi maf'oolaa
Innallaaha laa yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wa yaghfiru maa doona dhaalika liman yashaa'u wa man yushrik Billaahi faqadi iftaraa ithman azeemaa
Alam tara ilal-ladheena yuzakkoona anfusahum bali Allaahu yuzakkee man yashaa'u wa laa yuzlamoona fateelaa
Unzur kayfa yaftaroona alaa Allaahil-kadhiba wa kafaa bihi ithman mubeenaa
Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseeban minal-kitaabi yu'minoona bil-jibti wat-taaghooti wa yaqooloona lilladheena kafaroo haa'ulaa'i ahdaa minal-ladheena aamanoo sabeelaa
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena la-anahumu Allaahu wa man yal-ani Allaahu falan tajida lahu naseeraa
Am lahum naseebun minal-mulki fa-idhan laa yu'toonan-naasa naqeeraa
Am yahsudoonan-naasa alaa maa aataahumu Allaahu min fadlihi faqad aataynaa aala ibraaheemal-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa aataynaahum mulkan azeemaa
Faminhum man aamana bihi wa minhum man sadda anhu wa kafaa bijahannama sa'eeraa
Innal-ladheena kafaroo bi-aayaatinaa sawfa nusleehim naaran kullamaa nadijat julooduhum baddalnaahum juloodan ghayrahaa liyadhooqul-adhaaba innallaaha kaana azeezan hakeemaa
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati sanudkhiluhum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadan lahum feehaa azwaajun mutahharatun wa nudkhiluhum zillaa zaleelaa
Innallaaha ya'murukum an tu'uaddul-amaanaati ilaa ahlihaa wa idhaa hakamtum baynan-naasi an tahkumoo bil-adli innallaaha ni'immaa ya'izukum bihi innallaaha kaana samee'an baseeraa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee'oo Allaaha wa atee'ur-rasoola wa ulil-amri minkum fa-in tanaaza'tum fee shay'in faruddoohu ilaa Allaahi war-rasooli in kuntum tu'minoona Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri dhaalika khayrun wa ahsanu ta'weelaa

Alam tara ilal-ladheena yaz'umoona annahum aamanoo bimaa unzila ilayka wa maa unzila min qablika yureedoona an yatahaakamoo ilat-taaghooti wa qad umiroo an yakfuroo bihi wa yureedush-shaytaanu an yudillahum dalaalan ba'eedaa
Wa idhaa qeela lahum ta'aalaw ilaa maa anzala Allaahu wa ilar-rasooli ra'aytal-munaafiqeena yasuddoona anka sudoodaa
Fakayfa idhaa asaabathum museebatun bimaa qaddamat aydeehim thumma jaa'ooka yahlifoona Billaahi in aradnaa illaa ihsaanan wa tawfeeqaa
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena ya'lamu Allaahu maa fee quloobihim fa-a'rid anhum wa izhum wa qul lahum fee anfusihim qawlan baleeghaa
Wa maa arsalnaa min rasoolin illaa liyutaa'a bi-idhni Allaahi wa law annahum idh zalamoo anfusahum jaa'ooka fastaghfaroo Allaaha wastaghfara lahumur-rasoolu lawajadoo Allaaha tawwaaban Raheemaa
Falaa wa rabbika laa yu'minoona hattaa yuhakkimooka feemaa shajara baynahum thumma laa yajidoo fee anfusihim harajan mimmaa qadayta wa yusallimoo tasleemaa

Wa law annaa katabnaa alayhim aniq-tuloo anfusakum aw ukhrujoo min diyaarikum maa fa-aloohu illaa qaleelun minhum wa law annahum fa-aloo maa yoo'azoona bihi lakaana khayran lahum wa ashadda tathbeetaa
Wa idhan la-aataynaahum min ladunnaa ajran azeemaa
Wa lahadaynaahum siraatan mustaqeemaa
Wa man yuti'i Allaaha war-rasoola fa-ulaa'ika ma'al-ladheena an'ama Allaahu alayhim minan-nabiyyeena was-siddeeqeena wash-shuhadaa'i was-saaliheena wa hasuna ulaa'ika rafeeqaa
Dhaalikal-fadlu mina Allaahi wa kafaa Billaahi aleemaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo khudhoo hidhrakum fanfiroo thubaatin aw infiroo jamee'aa
Wa inna minkum laman layubatti'anna fa-in asaabatkum museebatun qaala qad an'ama Allaahu alayya idh lam akun ma'ahum shaheedaa
Wa la-in asaabakum fadlun mina Allaahi layaqoolanna ka'an lam takun baynakum wa baynahu mawaddatun yaa laytanee kuntu ma'ahum fa-afooza fawzan azeemaa
Falyuqaatil fee sabeelillaahil-ladheena yashroonal-hayaatad-dunyaa bil-aakhirati wa man yuqaatil fee sabeelillaahi fayuqtal aw yaghlib fasawfa nu'teehi ajran azeemaa

Wa maa lakum laa tuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi wal-mustad'afeena minar-rijaali wan-nisaa wal-wildaanil-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa akhrijnaa min haadhihil-qaryatiz-zaalimi ahluhaa waj'al lanaa min ladunka waliyyan waj'al lanaa min ladunka naseeraa
Al-ladheena aamanoo yuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena kafaroo yuqaatiloona fee sabeelit-taaghooti faqaatiloo awliyaa'ash-shaytaani inna kaydash-shaytaani kaana da'eefaa

Alam tara ilal-ladheena qeela lahum kuffoo aydiyakum wa aqeemus-salaata wa aatuz-zakaata falammaa kutiba alayhimul-qitaalu idhaa fareequn minhum yakhshawnan-naasa kakhashyati Allaahi aw ashadda khashyatan wa qaaloo rabbanaa lima katabta alaynal-qitaala lawlaa akhkhartanaa ilaa ajalin qareebin qul mataa'ud-dunyaa qaleelun wal-aakhiratu khayrun limani ittaqaa wa laa tuzlamoona fateelaa

Aynamaa takoonoo yudrikkumul-mawtu wa law kuntum fee buroojin mushayyadatin wa in tusibhum hasanatun yaqooloo haadhihi min indi Allaahi wa in tusibhum sayyi'atun yaqooloo haadhihi min indika qul kullun min indi Allaahi famaali haa'ulaa'il-qawmi laa yakaadoona yafqahoona hadeethaa
Maa asaabaka min hasanatin famina Allaahi wa maa asaabaka min sayyi'atin famin nafsika wa arsalnaaka lin-naasi rasoolan wa kafaa Billaahi shaheedaa
Man yuti'ir-rasoola faqad ataa'a Allaaha wa man tawallaa famaa arsalnaaka alayhim hafeezaa

Wa yaqooloona taa'atun fa-idhaa barazoo min indika bayyata taa'ifatun minhum ghayral-ladhee taqoolu Wallaahu yaktubu maa yubayyitoona fa-a'rid anhum wa tawakkal alaa Allaahi wa kafaa Billaahi wakeelaa
Afalaa yatadabbaroonal-qur'aana wa law kaana min indi ghayri Allaahi lawajadoo feehikh-tilaafan katheeraa

Wa idhaa jaa'ahum amrun minal-amni awil-khawfi adhaa'oo bihi wa law raddoohu ilar-rasooli wa ilaa ulil-amri minhum la-alimahul-ladheena yastanbitoonahu minhum wa lawlaa fadlu Allaahi alaykum wa rahmatuhu laattaba'tumush-shaytaana illaa qaleelaa
Faqaatil fee sabeelillaahi laa tukallafu illaa nafsaka wa harridil-mu'mineena asaa Allaahu an yakuffa ba'sal-ladheena kafaroo Wallaahu ashaddu ba'san wa ashaddu tankeelaa
Man yashfa shafaa'atan hasanatan yakun lahu naseebun minhaa wa man yashfa shafaa'atan sayyi'atan yakun lahu kiflun minhaa wa kaana Allaahu alaa kulli shay'in muqeetaa
Wa idhaa huyyeetum bitahiyyatin fahayyoo bi-ahsana minhaa aw ruddoohaa innallaaha kaana alaa kulli shay'in haseebaa
Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa layajma'annakum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feehi wa man asdaqu mina Allaahi hadeethaa
Famaa lakum fil-munaafiqeena fi'atayni Wallaahu arkasahum bimaa kasaboo atureedoona an tahdoo man adalla Allaahu wa man yudlili Allaahu falan tajida lahu sabeelaa

Waddoo law takfuroona kamaa kafaroo fatakoonoona sawaa'an falaa tattakhidhoo minhum awliyaa'a hattaa yuhaajiroo fee sabeelillaahi fa-in tawallaw fakhudhoohum waaqtuloohum haythu wajadtumoohum wa laa tattakhidhoo minhum waliyyan wa laa naseeraa

Illal-ladheena yasiloona ilaa qawmin baynakum wa baynahum meethaaqun aw jaa'ookum hasirat sudooruhum an yuqaatilookum aw yuqaatiloo qawmahum wa law shaa'a Allaahu lasallatahum alaykum falaqaatalookum fa-ini i'tazalookum falam yuqaatilookum wa alqaw ilaykumus-salama famaa ja'ala Allaahu lakum alayhim sabeelaa

Satajidoona aakhareena yureedoona an ya'manookum wa ya'manoo qawmahum kulla maa ruddoo ilal-fitnati urkisoo feehaa fa-in lam ya'tazilookum wa yulqoo ilaykumus-salama wa yakuffoo aydiyahum fakhudhoohum waaqtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum wa oola'ikum ja'alnaa lakum alayhim sultaanan mubeenaa

Wa maa kaana limu'minin an yaqtula mu'minan illaa khata'an wa man qatala mu'minan khata'an fatahreeru raqabatin mu'minatin wa diyatun musallamatun ilaa ahlihi illaa an yassaddaqoo fa-in kaana min qawmin aduwwin lakum wa huwa mu'minun fatahreeru raqabatin mu'minatin wa in kaana min qawmin baynakum wa baynahum meethaaqun fadiyatun musallamatun ilaa ahlihi wa tahreeru raqabatin mu'minatin faman lam yajid fasiyaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayni tawbatan mina Allaahi wa kaana Allaahu aleeman hakeemaa
Wa man yaqtul mu'minan muta'ammidan fajazaa'uuhu jahannamu khaalidan feehaa wa ghadiba Allaahu alayhi wa la-anahu wa a'adda lahu adhaaban azeemaa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa darabtum fee sabeelillaahi fatabayyanoo wa laa taqooloo liman alqaa ilaykumus-salaama lasta mu'minan tabtaghoona aradal-hayaatid-dunyaa fa-inda Allaahi maghaanimu katheeratun kadhaalika kuntum min qablu famanna Allaahu alaykum fatabayyanoo innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa

Laa yastawil-qaa'idoona minal-mu'mineena ghayru ulid-darari wal-mujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim faddala Allaahul-mujaahideena bi-amwaalihim wa anfusihim alal-qaa'ideena darajatan wa kullan wa-ada Allaahul-husnaa wa faddala Allaahul-mujaahideena alal-qaa'ideena ajran azeemaa
Darajaatin minhu wa maghfiratan wa rahmatan wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa

Innal-ladheena tawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu zaalimee anfusihim qaaloo feema kuntum qaaloo kunnaa mustad'afeena fil-ardi qaaloo alam takun ardu Allaahi waasi'atan fatuhaajiroo feehaa fa-ulaa'ika ma'waahum jahannamu wa saa'at maseeraa
Illal-mustad'afeena minar-rijaali wan-nisaa wal-wildaani laa yastatee'oona heelatan wa laa yahtadoona sabeelaa
Fa-ulaa'ika asaa Allaahu an ya'fuwa anhum wa kaana Allaahu afuwwan ghafooraa

Wa man yuhaajir fee sabeelillaahi yajid fil-ardi muraaghaman katheeran wa sa'atan wa man yakhruj min baytihi muhaajiran ilaa Allaahi wa rasoolihi thumma yudrikhul-mawtu faqad waqa'a ajruhu alaa Allaahi wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa
Wa idhaa darabtum fil-ardi falaysa alaykum junaahun an taqsuroo minas-salaati in khiftum an yaftinakumul-ladheena kafaroo innal-kaafireena kaanoo lakum aduwwan mubeenaa

Wa idhaa kunta feehim fa-aqamta lahumus-salaata faltaqum taa'ifatun minhum ma'aka wa lya'khudhoo aslihatahum fa-idhaa sajadoo falyakoonoo min waraa'ikum wa lta'ti taa'ifatun ukhraa lam yusalloo falyusalloo ma'aka wa lya'khudhoo hidhrahum wa aslihatahum waddal-ladheena kafaroo law taghfuloona an aslihatikum wa amti'atikum fayameeloona alaykum maylatan waahidatan wa laa junaaha alaykum in kaana bikum adhan min matarin aw kuntum mardaa an tada'oo aslihatakum wa khudhoo hidhrakum innallaaha a'adda lilkaafireena adhaaban muheenaa
Fa-idhaa qadaytumus-salaata fadhkuroo Allaaha qiyaaman wa qu'oodan wa alaa junoobikum fa-idhaa itma'nantum fa-aqeemus-salaata innas-salaata kaanat alal-mu'mineena kitaaban mawqootaa
Wa laa tahinoo fib-tighaa'il-qawmi in takoonoo ta'lamoona fa-innahum ya'lamoona kamaa ta'lamoona wa tarjoona mina Allaahi maa laa yarjoona wa kaana Allaahu aleeman hakeemaa
Innaa anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi litahkuma baynan-naasi bimaa araaka Allaahu wa laa takun lilkhaa'ineena khaseemaa
Wastaghfiri Allaaha innallaaha kaana ghafooran Raheemaa
Wa laa tujaadil anil-ladheena yakhtaanoona anfusahum innallaaha laa yuhibbu man kaana khawwaanan atheemaa
Yastakhfoona minan-naasi wa laa yastakhfoona mina Allaahi wa huwa ma'ahum idh yubayyitoona maa laa yardaa minal-qawli wa kaana Allaahu bimaa ya'maloona muheetaa
Haa'antum haa'ulaa'i jaadaltum anhum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa faman yujaadilu Allaaha anhum yawmal-qiyaamati am man yakoonu alayhim wakeelaa
Wa man ya'mal soo'an aw yazlim nafsahu thumma yastaghfiri Allaaha yajidi Allaaha ghafooran Raheemaa
Wa man yaksib ithman fa-innamaa yaksibuhu alaa nafsihi wa kaana Allaahu aleeman hakeemaa
Wa man yaksib khatee'atan aw ithman thumma yarmi bihi baree'an faqadi ihtamala buhtaanan wa ithman mubeenaa

Wa lawlaa fadlu Allaahi alayka wa rahmatuhu lahammat taa'ifatun minhum an yudillooka wa maa yudilloona illaa anfusahum wa maa yadurroonaka min shay'in wa anzala Allaahu alaykal-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa allamaka maa lam takun ta'lamu wa kaana fadlu Allaahi alayka azeemaa
Laa khayra fee katheerin min najwaahum illaa man amara bisadaqatin aw ma'roofin aw islaahin baynan-naasi wa man yaf'al dhaalika ibtighaa'a mardaati Allaahi fasawfa nu'teehi ajran azeemaa
Wa man yushaaqiqir-rasoola min ba'di maa tabayyana lahul-hudaa wa yattabi ghayra sabeelil-mu'mineena nuwallihi maa tawallaa wa nuslihi jahannama wa saa'at maseeraa
Innallaaha laa yaghfiru an yushraka bihi wa yaghfiru maa doona dhaalika liman yashaa'u wa man yushrik Billaahi faqad dalla dalaalan ba'eedaa
In yad'oona min doonihi illaa inaathan wa in yad'oona illaa shaytaanan mareedaa
La-anahu Allaahu wa qaala la-attakhidhanna min ibaadika naseeban mafroodaa

Wa la-udillannahum wa la-umanniyannahum wa la-aamurannahum falayubattikunna aadhaanal-an'aam wa la-aamurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqa Allaahi wa man yattakhidhish-shaytaana waliyyan min doonillaahi faqad khasira khusraanan mubeenaa
Ya'iduhum wa yumanneehim wa maa ya'iduhumush-shaytaanu illaa ghurooraa
Ulaa'ika ma'waahum jahannamu wa laa yajidoona anhaa maheesaa
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati sanudkhiluhum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadan wa'da Allaahi haqqan wa man asdaqu mina Allaahi qeelaa
Laysa bi-amaaniyyikum wa laa amaaniyyi ahlil-kitaabi man ya'mal soo'an yujza bihi wa laa yajid lahu min doonillaahi waliyyan wa laa naseeraa
Wa man ya'mal minas-saalihaati min dhakarin aw unthaa wa huwa mu'minun fa-ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata wa laa yuzlamoona naqeeraa
Wa man ahsanu deenan mimman aslama wajhahu Lillaahi wa huwa muhsinun wattaba'a millata ibraaheema haneefan wattakhadha Allaahu ibraaheema khaleelaa
Wa Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa kaana Allaahu bikulli shay'in muheetaa

Wa yastaftoonaka fin-nisaa quli Allaahu yufteekum feehinna wa maa yutlaa alaykum fil-kitaabi fee yataaman-nisaa al-laatee laa tu'toonahunna maa kutiba lahunna wa targhaboona an tankihoohunna wal-mustad'afeena minal-wildaani wa an taqoomoo lilyataamaa bil-qisti wa maa taf'aloo min khayrin fa-innallaaha kaana bihi aleemaa

Wa inim-ra'atun khaafat min ba'lihaa nushoozan aw i'raadan falaa junaaha alayhimaa an yuslihaa baynahumaa sulhan was-sulhu khayrun wa uhdiratil-anfusush-shuhha wa in tuhsinoo wa tattaqoo fa-innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa
Wa lan tastatee'oo an ta'diloo baynan-nisaa wa law harastum falaa tameeloo kullal-mayli fatadharoohaa kal-mu'allaqati wa in tuslihoo wa tattaqoo fa-innallaaha kaana ghafooran Raheemaa
Wa in yatafarraqaa yughni Allaahu kullaa min sa'atihi wa kaana Allaahu waasi'an hakeemaa

Wa Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa laqad wassaynal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum wa iyyaakum anit-taqoo Allaaha wa in takfuroo fa-inna Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa kaana Allaahu ghaniyyan hameedaa
Wa Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa kafaa Billaahi wakeelaa
In yasha yudhhibkum ayyuhan-naasu wa ya'ti bi-aakhareena wa kaana Allaahu alaa dhaalika qadeeraa
Man kaana yureedu thawaabad-dunyaa fa-inda Allaahi thawaabud-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa kaana Allaahu samee'an baseeraa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonoo qawwaameena bil-qisti shuhadaa'a Lillaahi wa law alaa anfusikum awil-waalidayni wal-aqrabeena in yakun ghaniyyan aw faqeeran fa-Allaahu awlaa bihimaa falaa tattabi'ul-hawaa an ta'diloo wa in talwoo aw tu'ridoo fa-innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo aaminoo Billaahi wa rasoolihi wal-kitaabil-ladhee nazzala alaa rasoolihi wal-kitaabil-ladhee anzala min qablu wa man yakfur Billaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulihi wal-yawmil-aakhiri faqad dalla dalaalan ba'eedaa
Innal-ladheena aamanoo thumma kafaroo thumma aamanoo thumma kafaroo thumma izdaadoo kufran lam yakuni Allaahu liyaghfira lahum wa laa liyahdiyahum sabeelaa
Bashshiril-munaafiqeena bi-anna lahum adhaaban aleemaa
Al-ladheena yattakhidhoonal-kaafireena awliyaa'a min doonil-mu'mineena ayabtaghoona indahumul-izzata fa-innal-izzata Lillaahi jamee'aa

Wa qad nazzala alaykum fil-kitaabi an idhaa sami'tum aayaati Allaahi yukfaru bihaa wa yustahza'u bihaa falaa taq'udoo ma'ahum hattaa yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrihi innakum idhan mithluhum innallaaha jaami'ul-munaafiqeena wal-kaafireena fee jahannama jamee'aa

Al-ladheena yatarabbasoona bikum fa-in kaana lakum fathun mina Allaahi qaaloo alam nakun ma'akum wa in kaana lilkaafireena naseebun qaaloo alam nastahwidh alaykum wa namna'kum minal-mu'mineena fa-Allaahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyaamati wa lan yaj'ala Allaahu lilkaafireena alal-mu'mineena sabeelaa
Innal-munaafiqeena yukhaadi'oona Allaaha wa huwa khaadi'uhum wa idhaa qaamoo ilas-salaati qaamoo kusaalaa yuraa'oonan-naasa wa laa yadhkuroona Allaaha illaa qaleelaa
Mudhabdhabeena bayna dhaalika laa ilaa haa'ulaa'i wa laa ilaa haa'ulaa'i wa man yudlili Allaahu falan tajida lahu sabeelaa
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-kaafireena awliyaa'a min doonil-mu'mineena atureedoona an taj'aloo Lillaahi alaykum sultaanan mubeenaa
Innal-munaafiqeena fid-darkil-asfali minan-naari wa lan tajida lahum naseeraa
Illal-ladheena taaboo wa aslahoo wa'tasamoo Billaahi wa akhlasoo deenahum Lillaahi fa-ulaa'ika ma'al-mu'mineena wa sawfa yu'ti Allaahul-mu'mineena ajran azeemaa
Maa yaf'alu Allaahu bi-adhaabikum in shakartum wa aamantum wa kaana Allaahu shaakiran aleemaa
Laa yuhibbu Allaahul-jahra bis-soo'i minal-qawli illaa man zulima wa kaana Allaahu samee'an aleemaa
In tubdoo khayran aw tukhfoohu aw ta'foo an soo'in fa-innallaaha kaana afuwwan qadeeraa

Innal-ladheena yakfuroona Billaahi wa rusulihi wa yureedoona an yufarriqoo bayna Allaahi wa rusulihi wa yaqooloona nu'minu biba'din wa nakfuru biba'din wa yureedoona an yattakhidhoo bayna dhaalika sabeelaa
Ulaa'ika humul-kaafiroona haqqan wa a'tadnaa lilkaafireena adhaaban muheenaa
Wal-ladheena aamanoo Billaahi wa rusulihi wa lam yufarriqoo bayna ahadin minhum ulaa'ika sawfa yu'teehim ujoorahum wa kaana Allaahu ghafooran Raheemaa

Yas'aluka ahlul-kitaabi an tunazzila alayhim kitaaban minas-samaa'i faqad sa'aloo moosaa akbara min dhaalika faqaaloo arinaa Allaaha jahratan fa-akhadhathumus-saa'iqatu bizulmihim thumma ittakhadhul-ijla min ba'di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu fa-afawnaa an dhaalika wa aataynaa moosaa sultaanan mubeenaa
Wa rafa'naa fawqahumut-toora bimeethaaqihim wa qulnaa lahum udkhulul-baaba sujjadan wa qulnaa lahumu laa ta'doo fis-sabti wa akhadhnaa minhum meethaaqan ghaleezaa

Fabimaa naqdihim meethaaqahum wa kufrihim bi-aayaati Allaahi wa qatlihimul-anbiyaa'a bighayri haqqin wa qawlihim quloobunaa ghulfun bal taba'a Allaahu alayhaa bikufrihim falaa yu'minoona illaa qaleelaa
Wa bikufrihim wa qawlihim alaa maryama buhtaanan azeemaa

Wa qawlihim innaa qatalnal-maseeha eesab-na maryama rasoola Allaahi wa maa qataloohu wa maa salaboohu wa laakin shubbiha lahum wa innal-ladheena ikhtalafoo feehi lafee shakkin minhu maa lahum bihi min ilmin illat-tibaa'az-zanni wa maa qataloohu yaqeenaa
Bal rafa'ahu Allaahu ilayhi wa kaana Allaahu azeezan hakeemaa
Wa in min ahlil-kitaabi illaa layu'minanna bihi qabla mawtihi wa yawmal-qiyaamati yakoonu alayhim shaheedaa
Fabizulmin minal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa alayhim tayyibaatin uhillat lahum wa bisaddihim an sabeelillaahi katheeraa
Wa akhdhihimur-ribaa wa qad nuhoo anhu wa aklihim amwaalan-naasi bil-baatili wa a'tadnaa lilkaafireena minhum adhaaban aleemaa

Lakinir-raasikhoona fil-ilmi minhum wal-mu'minoona yu'minoona bimaa unzila ilayka wa maa unzila min qablika wal-muqeemeenas-salaata wal-mu'toonaz-zakaata wal-mu'minoona Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri ulaa'ika sanu'teehim ajran azeemaa

Innaa awhaynaa ilayka kamaa awhaynaa ilaa noohin wan-nabiyyeena min ba'dihi wa awhaynaa ilaa ibraaheema wa ismaa'eela wa ishaaqa wa ya'qooba wal-asbaati wa eesaa wa ayyooba wa yoonus wa haaroona wa sulaymaana wa aataynaa daawooda zabooraa
Wa rusulan qad qasasnaahum alayka min qablu wa rusulan lam naqsushum alayka wa kallama Allaahu moosaa takleemaa
Rusulan mubashshireena wa mundhireena li'llaa yakoona lin-naasi alaa Allaahi hujjatun ba'dar-rusuli wa kaana Allaahu azeezan hakeemaa
Lakini Allaahu yashhadu bimaa anzala ilayka anzalahu bi-ilmihi wal-malaa'ikatu yashhadoona wa kafaa Billaahi shaheedaa
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wa saddoo an sabeelillaahi qad dalloo dalaalan ba'eedaa
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wa zalamoo lam yakuni Allaahu liyaghfira lahum wa laa liyahdiyahum tareeqaa
Illaa tareeqa jahannama khaalideena feehaa abadan wa kaana dhaalika alaa Allaahi yaseeraa
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akumur-rasoolu bil-haqqi min rabbikum fa-aaminoo khayran lakum wa in takfuroo fa-inna Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa kaana Allaahu aleeman hakeemaa

Yaa ahlal-kitaabi laa taghloo fee deenikum wa laa taqooloo alaa Allaahi illal-haqqa innamal-maseehu eesab-nu maryama rasoolullaahi wa kalimatuhu alqaahaa ilaa maryama wa roohun minhu fa-aaminoo Billaahi wa rusulihi wa laa taqooloo thalaathatun intahoo khayran lakum innamaa Allaahu ilaahun waahidun subhaanahu an yakoona lahu waladun lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa kafaa Billaahi wakeelaa
Lan yastankifal-maseehu an yakoona abdan Lillaahi wa lal-malaa'ikatul-muqarraboona wa man yastankif an ibaadatihi wa yastakbir fasayahshuruhum ilayhi jamee'aa

Fa-ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati fayuwaffeehim ujoorahum wa yazeeduhum min fadlihi wa ammal-ladheena istankafoo wastakbaroo fayu'adhdhibuhum adhaaban aleeman wa laa yajidoona lahum min doonillaahi waliyyan wa laa naseeraa
Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akum burhaanun min rabbikum wa anzalnaa ilaykum nooran mubeenaa
Fa-ammal-ladheena aamanoo Billaahi wa'tasamoo bihi fasayudkhiluhum fee rahmatin minhu wa fadlin wa yahdeehim ilayhi siraatan mustaqeemaa

Yastaftoonaka quli Allaahu yufteekum fil-kalaalati inim-ru'uun halaka laysa lahu waladun wa lahu ukhtun falahaa nisfu maa taraka wa huwa yarithuhaa in lam yakun lahaa waladun fa-in kaanataa ithnatayni falahumath-thuluthaani mimmaa taraka wa in kaanoo ikhwatan rijaalan wa nisaa'an falildhdhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayni yubayyinu Allaahu lakum an tadilloo Wallaahu bikulli shay'in aleem
